sn56.15:1.1: dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave, “mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
sn56.15:1.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn56.15:1.3: ahaṃ kho bhante, dhāremi. “bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
sn56.15:1.4: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, dhāresi “mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
sn56.15:1.5: dukkhaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.15:1.6: dukkhasamudayo khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.15:1.7: dukkhanirodho khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.15:1.8: dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.15:1.9: evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante, dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.15:2.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.15:2.3: dukkhaṃ kho bhikkhu, mayā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.15:2.4: dukkhasamudayo kho bhikkhu, mayā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.15:2.5: dukkhanirodho kho bhikkhu, mayā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.15:2.6: dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā kho bhikkhu, mayā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.15:2.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, dhārehi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.15:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhu idaṃ “dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ “dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
